_about: Human-authored gold draft for nb05. Paths can be written in shorthand (e.g. 'docs/api/map/map-mixins.md' without the 'kdk/' prefix); scripts/build_layered_gold.py resolves them to canonical corpus rel_paths and refuses to publish on any unresolved path. Three layers test different retrieval modes: A_symbol (exact identifier lookup), B_docs (natural-language → documentation), C_code (concept → implementation). Negatives have empty gold_sources and test rejection. FR queries are written to mirror how a French developer actually phrases things (no subject-inversion, dev jargon often left in English, plain conjugations).
